name: craft-tools
description: MCP access to ArtCraft's creative apps: FigCraft for UI design, FilmCraft for video, AniCraft for 2D animation, EffectCraft for motion graphics, and VectorCraft for vector illustration. Includes cross-platform CLI guidance for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
suggestedPrompts: Inspect this VectorCraft document and export a PDF
Create a 3-second AniCraft animation and render a GIF
Add a title animation to my EffectCraft comp and render a preview
